title: The OG Box Fan
body:
The fan your grandma had. The fan your parents had. The fan YOU need. No frills, just legendary airflow. Fits perfectly in windows.

Features:
- 20" blade
- 3 speeds
- Window-ready
- Stackable for storage
- Built to last forever
summary: The fan your grandma had. The fan your parents had. No frills, just legendary airflow.

comments.content: I came here expecting something else but honestly? I needed a ceiling fan anyway. Great selection!
